description: This file contains the implementation of the Cart controller for the checkout process in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages actions such as displaying the cart, adding items, listing cart contents, and handling vouchers, tariffs, and other cart-related functionalities.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the checkout cart, including displaying, listing, adding products, and handling cart contents within the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the checkout cart, including displaying, listing, adding, editing, and removing products within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the cart page with breadcrumbs, cart items, totals, and checkout options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the JSON response with the list of cart items by invoking getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the cart list with all cart items, prices, options, vouchers, totals, and other cart details.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the addition of products to the cart, including processing product IDs, quantities, options, subscriptions, and related parameters from POST requests.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles editing/updating cart items based on key, quantity, and other options, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cart item based on key, updates the cart, and returns a JSON response.
